name: Practice Mapper
description: Adds a layout-aware Practice button to online level menus, reads approved mappings from the public GitHub JSON with optional API fallback, and opens the mapped practice level when one exists.

issues.info: Need help, want to submit mappings, or want to report a broken one? Join the <cp>Practice Mapper Discord</c> or open a GitHub issue.

approved-mappings-url.name: Approved Mappings URL
approved-mappings-url.description: Public JSON file used for approved mapping lookups before API fallback.

api-base-url.name: API Base URL
api-base-url.description: Optional fallback API used if the approved mappings URL is unavailable.
